content:
**The first We Ride at Dawn is retired.**
Its nightly PvP league had stopped finding a second board to fight, so the old link now sends you here:
https://jelledenmark.github.io/we-ride-at-dawn-2/
WRAD2 is a new game, so you start a fresh horde. Every night at 22:00 it duels every other horde: 3 points for a win, 1 for a draw, most points by Sunday wins.
If you installed the old game on your phone, open it once: it clears itself out and sends you on. Then add WRAD2 to your home screen instead.
